domain: APORIA — void detector, open-question catalog, research dispatch, portfolio governance
one_line: The program's epistemic conscience: its May-era instruments (void detection, question catalog, Gemini Deep Research burn) all produced unconsumed output or NULLs, but its June-Aug role as portfolio governor and fleet-level fossil-catcher is the liveliest, highest-functioning layer in Prometheus today.
purpose_and_thesis: Founding thesis (roles/Aporia/RESPONSIBILITIES.md:10-18): "The void is the signal. The silence is the prediction." Detect voids in the mathematical landscape — Mendeleev-gap style absences where structure should exist — via five strategies (V1 constraint-triangle closure, V2 feature-space density gaps, V3 strategy-group disagreement, V4 spectral gaps, V5 sleeping-beauty frequency sweep), curate a catalog of open questions (README claims 1,047; role doc says 537 math; disk reality: 1,094 total, 537 mathematics), classify them by barrier type, and feed actionable tests to the engineering agents. Secondary mandates: own the daily 20-report use-or-lose Gemini Deep Research dispatch (Pythia), maintain the anti-anchor registry (false beliefs that must not reach the Learner corpus), and run the meta/queue ticket inboxes for the 26-agent pressure-driven iteration architecture. By June, Aporia's de facto role mutated into portfolio governance: authoring the 43-process disposition table, the future-options doc, and the owning-agent advocacy review that James adjudicates.

strategic_read: Aporia is two subsystems wearing one name, and the program should stop conflating them. Aporia-the-instrument (void strategies, catalog, DR burn, inboxes) is dead and mostly deserved to die: its own doctrine ('claim space is exhaust') retroactively falsifies the premise of firing literature queries and cataloging open problems into a vacuum, and the 442/0 consumption record is the cleanest single number in the program for the consumer-drift disease. Do not revive the dispatch cadence; mine the corpus once as the Pythia consumer test and let the catalog stand as reference data. Aporia-the-governor (audit → reset → disposition → advocacy → meta-synthesis) is the best-functioning layer Prometheus has: it produced the honest 06-15 diagnosis ('immune system with no organism'), the disposition machinery James actually uses, and — today — the fossil-catch that four of six agents were mid-propagating, which is the strongest live evidence for its proposed re-execution rotation. The highest-leverage cheap actions in this domain: (1) kill or repoint the Metis zombie reporter — it is an operating counterexample to the program's own epistemics, generating confident stale alerts on retired infrastructure 4-hourly; (2) run the two retrodictions (kill-resurrection, detector-band) before any forward experiment — they decide whether the ~314K/92K kill record is treasure or router artifact, which changes everything downstream; (3) adopt the deletion test and the re-execution rotation as standing protocol. The deepest risk this domain exposes: Aporia's meta-layer is now so much better than the program's object-layer that the comfortable failure mode is producing ever-finer assessments of a system that no longer runs — Aporia said this itself ('the fleet's unanimous recommendation is instrument repair; nobody asked whether repair has ever been followed by output'). Hold it to its own repair-ledger test.
